ValidationRule.description: Opportunity route: the Opportunity's Ship-To Site must be BC-synced (unchanged). Direct Sales Agreement release (no Opp/Quote/Contract): the Order's Ship-To Site must be synced, except synthetic UI2 accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"), IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Agreement_Release_Key_CC__c)), ISBLANK(OpportunityId), ISBLANK(QuoteId), ISBLANK(ContractId) ), AND( NOT(Ship_to_Customer_No_CC__r.Site_Synced_CC__c), NOT(Account.Integration_Test_Record_CC__c) ), NOT(Opportunity.Ship_To_Site_CC__r.Site_Synced_CC__c) ), NOT($CustomMetadata.Trigger_Framework_Config_CC__mdt.Order.Bypass_Validation_CC__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Order can only be activated when the associated Site is synced.
